Thank you for flagging it, and before I say anything about the figure, could you confirm which version of the file you are looking at? The one from the fourteenth, or the one we reissued on the seventeenth? Right. Then two things. You are right that the description on that line was unclear, and I will change it in every report from now on. On the amount, though, I stand by it: the four thousand is a warehouse invoice that arrived after your export was taken, and it is backed up by the invoice itself, which I am attaching now. So neither number was wrong. They were taken on different dates. We will reconcile both versions line by line and come back to you before the end of the day.

I told him it was an invoice that landed after his export, and that we would send it across today. I conceded one thing: he said the description on the line was unclear, and he was right, so we are changing that wording everywhere. What I need from you: cross-check both versions against the invoices and come back to me before the end of the day. Not tomorrow morning. Today.
